data.name: Shivatmaja
data.gender_notes: Shivatmaja is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A soul born from the divine energy of Lord Shiva, often symbolizing enlightenment and inner strength. The name Shivatmaja carries the meaning “Soul Born of Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Shivatmaja usually hope their child will grow to embody soul born of shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The divine spark within, linked to the ultimate reality.
data.etymology: Shivatmaja belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soul Born of Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivatmaja total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.spiritual_significance: A soul imbued with the essence of Lord Shiva, reflecting inner strength, resilience, and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shivatmaja is a name that signifies the embodiment of Shiva's essence within an individual. It symbolizes the merging of the self (atma) with the supreme consciousness of Shiva, leading to enlightenment and inner peace.

vedic_reference.note: Not found in Vedas or Upanishads

historical_references.reference: Shivatmaja was an epithet used for Queen Laxmi Bai of Jhansi during the Indian Rebellion of 1857. She is also known as Rani Laxmi Bai and is revered as a symbol of bravery and patriotism in Indian history.

Another Hindu deity known as Shivatmaja is the goddess Shivadurga, who is considered the presiding deity of the fort of the same name in Karnataka. The fort is believed to have been built in the 7th century CE and the goddess is believed to have protected it throughout its history.

modern_usage.modern_context: In modern times, the name 'Shivatmaja' is often used in the context of Hinduism, spirituality, and yoga. It is a revered title given to those who are believed to have a deep connection with Lord Shiva, the supreme god in Hinduism. On Instagram, you can find several accounts dedicated to Shivatmaja, filled with images and messages that celebrate the divine power and presence of Lord Shiva. On Facebook, there are many groups and pages where people discuss and share their experiences and beliefs related to Shivatmaja and Lord Shiva. On Pinterest, you can find numerous boards and pins dedicated to Shivatmaja, showcasing beautiful images and quotes that inspire and uplift. Overall, the use of 'Shivatmaja' in modern contexts reflects the enduring appeal of Hinduism, spirituality, and yoga, and the desire of people to connect with the divine and find inner peace in their daily lives.
